description: This file defines the interface and class for em_steering, which handles client steering requests, association control, BTM reports, acknowledgments, and message processing for a Wi-Fi mesh system. It includes numerous virtual functions for system-specific implementations and internal methods for crafting TLV data structures.
published: int send_frame(unsigned char *buff, unsigned int len, bool multicast)
int process_msg(unsigned char *data, unsigned int len)
